messages:
Nina: Quick note from todays sweep: scanner found a handful of legacy-s3 image 403s and a couple of external gist links that time out. None have CODEOWNERS. Can someone volunteer to bundle fixes?

Carlos: Drop an example path and i'll take a look this afternoon.

Nina: Example: /kb/runtime/timeout-retries.md uses `https://legacy-s3.redwood/diag/timeout-step.png` (403) and links to `https://gist.github.com/jdoe/1234`.

lee: I can rehost the image to /assets/docs/runtime and replace the gist with `{{< include-snippet "runtime/timeout-commands" >}}`. Will add alt text and a redirect frontmatter for the old gist.

docs-bot: Scan alert: orphan-image (low) in /kb/runtime/timeout-retries.md; no owners matched.

Carlos: If you open a PR tag me. Small reminder: CI blocks new asset paths unless infra allowlist updated; add infra note in the PR if CI fails.

lee: Will do. ETA: PR by EOD.

Nina: Thanks both. If anyone else sees legacy-s3 references run `rg "legacy-s3.redwood" docs/kb | sed -n '1,200p'` and paste results here so we can batch.
